checkpoint_rule: reuse the validation-selected batch-0 policy without reuse-specific selection
case_order: for each SoC in the stated order, enumerate paths 0 through 3
path_model: exact-step correlated OU innovations followed by reflection, 96 held 15-minute observations, initial residuals zero
gpu_rule: CUDA is selected when utilization is below 85 percent and free memory exceeds 2048 MiB; otherwise CPU. Device and load are recorded per benchmark group.
timing: Warm resident model and worker startup are measured separately. Simulation wall times include action construction, inference, transfer, hard accounting and dynamics. MIQP wall times use up to four one-thread processes. Batch-0 training and validation time is accounted for separately in amortization projections.
quality: Quality summaries use the N=12 run: SoC strata, paired path costs, observed maximum daily cost and fee-exceedance duration. Four independent exogenous paths do not support population tail-risk or transfer claims.
scope: One trained value function is reused without retraining. Changing controller changes the simulated policy; speed does not certify equivalent MIQP decisions. Tariff, season, dynamics and equipment remain fixed.
